request.description: Reduce the excessive three-quarter turn of these wearable wing accessories. Redraw at a very gentle 15 degree front-right yaw for a character standing only slightly diagonally. Both wings should remain broadly visible, with only mild perspective: the far right wing about 90 percent the apparent width of the near left wing. Keep their upper tips almost level, at most 3 pixels height difference. Do not roll or tilt the entire pair in the image plane. Preserve a tiny connected central back clasp and the same design, colors and native pixel-art detail. Wings only, no character, transparent background, one static pose. Aim for subtle asymmetry, between frontal symmetry and the current exaggerated turn.
